FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'Enchanté' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yes
   B. Pleased to meet you
   C. Mrs, Madam
   D. goodbye

2. What does 'le bébé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the child
   B. the boy
   C. the mother
   D. the baby

3. How do you say 'Here is my grandmother.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Voici ma famille.
   B. Voici ma grand-mère.
   C. C'est ma mère.
   D. J'ai un frère et une sœur.

4. What does 'la mère' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the sister
   B. the grandfather
   C. the mother
   D. the grandmother

5. How do you say 'The book is on the table.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le livre est sur la table.
   B. C'est un lit.
   C. Voici ma maison.
   D. Mets le livre dans la chambre.

6. What does 'le sac' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the ball
   B. the sofa
   C. the bag
   D. the kitchen

7. What does 'derrière' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. under
   B. in front of
   C. behind
   D. in

8. How do you say 'On Monday, I go to school.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.
   B. Le lundi, je vais à l'école.
   C. Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?
   D. Le jeudi, je chante.

9. What number is 'quatorze' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 13
   D. 18

10. What number is 'dix-neuf' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 8
   C. 12
   D. 14

11. How do you say 'It is a cake.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je mange une mangue.
   B. Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.
   C. C'est un gâteau.
   D. J'aime la mangue.

12. What does 'les légumes' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the banana
   B. vegetables
   C. chicken
   D. cheese

13. What does 'la bouche' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the mouth
   B. the head
   C. the knee
   D. the hand

14. Fill in: J'ai ______ nez. (1) (1 mark)
   A. deux
   B. des
   C. une
   D. un

15. What does 'le tapis' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the shop
   B. the garden
   C. the rug
   D. the key

16. What does 'Ça s'écrit comment ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My name is Njeri.
   B. Good evening, Madam!
   C. How do you spell it?
   D. Yes, I am fine.

17. What does 'Comment tu t'appelles ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Good evening, Madam!
   B. What is your name?
   C. Hello, Amina!
   D. And you?

18. What does 'Le lundi, je vais à l'école.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tomorrow it is Thursday.
   B. Today it is Monday.
   C. On Thursday, I sing.
   D. On Monday, I go to school.

19. What does 'Bon anniversaire !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I sing and I dance.
   B. My birthday is on 30 June.
   C. Happy birthday!
   D. There is a cake and there are balloons.

20. Fill in: le ______ janvier (the first of January) (1 mark)
   A. deux
   B. premier
   C. dernier
   D. un

21. What does 'Je chante et je danse.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I sing and I dance.
   B. Thank you very much!
   C. I am nine years old.
   D. When is your birthday?

22. Read: Le matin, je mange du pain et je bois du thé. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots. Le soir, je mange du poisson. Question: What does the speaker eat at midday? (1 mark)
   A. fish
   B. bread
   C. rice and beans
   D. a banana

23. Which little word goes with 'bras' (the arm)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. l'
   C. la
   D. les

24. Which is harsh weather? (1 mark)
   A. il fait chaud
   B. le beau temps
   C. le soleil
   D. l'orage

25. What does 'Il y a du vent.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. There is a storm.
   B. It is sunny.
   C. It is cloudy.
   D. It is windy.

26. Which little word goes with 'pluie' (the rain)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. les

27. What does 'Elle est sous la chaise.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is under the chair.
   B. You are welcome!
   C. Where is the key?
   D. Excuse me, where is the school?

28. Which little word goes with 'tapis' (the rug)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. la
   C. le
   D. les

29. Fill in: ______ frère s'appelle Kamau. (1 mark)
   A. Une
   B. La
   C. Ma
   D. Mon

30. How do you say 'the brother' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le père
   B. le frère
   C. la famille
   D. la grand-mère

31. How do you say 'the baby' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la grand-mère
   B. la famille
   C. le père
   D. le bébé

32. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'window'? (1 mark)
   A. fenêtre
   B. fenêre
   C. fenetre
   D. fene´tre

33. How do you say 'on' in French? (1 mark)
   A. sous
   B. entre
   C. devant
   D. sur

34. How do you say 'Friday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. lundi
   B. samedi
   C. vendredi
   D. mercredi

35. How do we write days of the week inside a French sentence? (1 mark)
   A. with a small letter
   B. all in capitals
   C. with a capital letter
   D. with an accent

36. How do you say 'Saturday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. lundi
   B. samedi
   C. mercredi
   D. dimanche

37. How do you write the number 11 in French? (1 mark)
   A. cinq
   B. onze
   C. deux
   D. dix-sept

38. How do you write the number 19 in French? (1 mark)
   A. deux
   B. dix-neuf
   C. vingt
   D. trente et un

39. How do you say 'the nose' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la jambe
   B. le doigt
   C. le nez
   D. la dent

40. How do you say 'to the left' in French? (1 mark)
   A. à côté de
   B. près de
   C. tout droit
   D. à gauche

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the seven days of the week in French in order. (4 marks) (4 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'My name is Njeri.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Translate into French: 'It is cloudy.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Une semaine, sept jours.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Write a birthday card of four lines to a friend called Njeri. (4 marks) (4 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'Le chat est derrière la porte.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Write the French words for: straight ahead, Excuse me, Go (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'It is a bed.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

49. Translate into French: 'He has short hair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

50. Translate into French: 'It is not good for your health.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

51. Translate into French: 'I like milk.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

52. Write and read aloud a short greeting for a card to a girl called Njeri. Write what you would say. (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Translate into English: 'Elle est sous la chaise.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

54. Write a short greeting dialogue of four lines in French between two friends who meet in the morning. Include their names. (4 marks) (4 marks)

55. Translate into French: 'The ball is behind the door.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

56. Translate into English: 'Tu as quel âge ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

57. Translate into French: 'It is snowing.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

58. Translate into English: 'Qui est-ce ?' (2 marks) (2 marks)

59. Translate into English: 'Le sac est dans la chambre.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

60. Translate into English: 'Je m'appelle Njeri.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

61. Translate into French: 'I have a nose.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Pleased to meet you
   Enchanté means Pleased to meet you.

2. D — the baby
   le bébé means the baby.

3. B — Voici ma grand-mère.
   Here is my grandmother. in French is Voici ma grand-mère.

4. C — the mother
   la mère means the mother.

5. A — Le livre est sur la table.
   The book is on the table. in French is Le livre est sur la table.

6. C — the bag
   le sac means the bag.

7. C — behind
   derrière means behind.

8. B — Le lundi, je vais à l'école.
   On Monday, I go to school. in French is Le lundi, je vais à l'école.

9. B — 14
   quatorze means 14.

10. A — 19
   dix-neuf means 19.

11. C — C'est un gâteau.
   It is a cake. in French is C'est un gâteau.

12. B — vegetables
   les légumes means vegetables.

13. A — the mouth
   la bouche means the mouth.

14. D — un
   Nez is masculine, so un nez.

15. C — the rug
   le tapis means the rug.

16. C — How do you spell it?
   Ça s'écrit comment ? means How do you spell it?

17. B — What is your name?
   Comment tu t'appelles ? means What is your name?

18. D — On Monday, I go to school.
   Le lundi, je vais à l'école. means On Monday, I go to school.

19. C — Happy birthday!
   Bon anniversaire ! means Happy birthday!

20. B — premier
   The first day of a month is le premier.

21. A — I sing and I dance.
   Je chante et je danse. means I sing and I dance.

22. C — rice and beans
   Du riz et des haricots.

23. A — le
   bras is masculine, so we say le bras.

24. D — l'orage
   A storm can be dangerous.

25. D — It is windy.
   Il y a du vent. means It is windy.

26. A — la
   pluie is feminine, so we say la pluie.

27. A — It is under the chair.
   Elle est sous la chaise. means It is under the chair.

28. C — le
   tapis is masculine, so we say le tapis.

29. D — Mon
   Frère is masculine, so we say mon.

30. B — le frère
   the brother in French is le frère.

31. D — le bébé
   the baby in French is le bébé.

32. A — fenêtre
   The correct spelling is fenêtre, with its accents.

33. D — sur
   on in French is sur.

34. C — vendredi
   Friday in French is vendredi.

35. A — with a small letter
   French days are written with a small letter unless they start a sentence.

36. B — samedi
   Saturday in French is samedi.

37. B — onze
   11 in French is onze.

38. B — dix-neuf
   19 in French is dix-neuf.

39. C — le nez
   the nose in French is le nez.

40. D — à gauche
   to the left in French is à gauche.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: lundi, mardi, mercredi, jeudi, vendredi, samedi, dimanche
   Working / marking points: 4 marks for all correct in order; lose 1 mark for every two errors.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Je m'appelle Njeri.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Il y a des nuages.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: A week, seven days.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: Chère Njeri, Bon anniversaire ! Voici un cadeau pour toi. Ton ami, Kamau
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for chère Njeri, 1 mark for the wish, 1 mark for a sentence and 1 mark for the ending.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: The cat is behind the door.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: tout droit, Excusez-moi, Allez
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: C'est un lit.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Il a les cheveux courts.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: Ce n'est pas bon pour la santé.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 4 marks in total.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: J'aime le lait.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Bonjour, Njeri ! Ça va ? Au revoir !
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a greeting, 1 mark for her name, 1 mark for an extra correct phrase.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is under the chair.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: Bonjour, Amina ! Salut, Kamau ! Comment tu t'appelles ? Je m'appelle Amina. (any correct four-line dialogue)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a greeting, 1 mark for a question, 1 mark for je m'appelle with a name, 1 mark for correct spelling and punctuation.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Le ballon est derrière la porte.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: How old are you?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: Il neige.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: Who is it?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: The bag is in the bedroom.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: My name is Njeri.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: J'ai un nez.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.
